summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests TSR-042 or dostarlimab, given before standard chemoradiation and surgery, in people with locally advanced mismatch repair deficient solid tumors, including rectal and endometrial cancer. The study drug is given by IV infusion over 30 minutes every 3 weeks for up to 6 months (9 cycles of 21 days), and capecitabine is taken by mouth with radiation therapy (infusional 5-FU is an alternative if oral medicine cannot be tolerated). The record says the study looks at whether the treatment is effective and at its safety, and the primary outcome is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa TSR-042 o dostarlimab, administrados antes de la quimiorradiación y la cirugía estándar, en personas con tumores sólidos localmente avanzados con deficiencia en la reparación de errores de apareamiento, incluido el cáncer de recto y el cáncer endometrial. El medicamento del estudio se administra por infusión intravenosa durante 30 minutos cada 3 semanas, por hasta 6 meses (9 ciclos de 21 días), y la capecitabina se toma por vía oral junto con radioterapia (el 5-FU en infusión es una alternativa si no se puede tolerar el medicamento oral). El registro indica que el estudio analiza si el tratamiento es eficaz y su seguridad, y el resultado principal no está indicado.
who_for: Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
Locally advanced solid tumor, or endometrial cancer clinically FIGO stage I or II (cohort 3).
Tumor shows mismatch repair deficiency or MSI-H status.
No evidence of distant metastases; disease is measurable or clinically evaluable.
Adequate blood counts, kidney, liver and clotting lab values.
not_for: Prior radiation, chemotherapy, or surgery for the tumor.
Prior therapy targeting T-cell co-stimulation or checkpoint pathways (cohorts 1 and 3).
Known HIV, active hepatitis B or C, or pregnancy or breastfeeding.
